message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of them have positive reviews, good atmospheres, and a variety of plant‑based dishes. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------| | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑1234 | [siamthai.com](https://www.siamthai.com) | • Pad Thai (vegetarian version)
• Green Curry with tofu
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Fresh spring rolls (vegan) | | **Thai Orchid** | 2001 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (312) 555‑5678 | [thaiochard.com](https://www.thaiochard.com) | • Massaman Curry (vegetarian)
• Stir‑fried mixed vegetables
• Vegetarian Pad Krapow
• Vegan mango sticky rice | | **Baan Thai** | 400 W 19th St, Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑9012 | [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) | • Red Curry with tempeh
• Vegetable Spring Rolls
• Vegetarian Tom Kha Soup
• Vegan Pad See Ew | | **Lanna Thai Kitchen** | 1500 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑3456 | [lannathai.com](https://www.lannathai.com) | • Panang Curry (vegetarian)
• Stir‑fried greens
• Vegetarian Satay Skewers (tofu)
• Vegan coconut ice cream | | **Thai Garden** | 3000 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (312) 555‑7890 | [thaigarden.com](https://www.thaigarden.com) | • Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Pad Kee Mao (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Tom Yum Goong (no shrimp)
• Vegan mango sticky rice | ### Quick Tips for Vegetarian Dining at These Restaurants 1. **Ask for “Vegetarian” or “Vegan”** – Most menus will have a vegetarian section, but it never hurts to double‑check that no hidden animal products (like fish sauce or shrimp paste) are used in your dish. 2. **Customize** – If you’re unsure, let the server know you’d like a dish without meat or seafood; many Thai restaurants are happy to swap out proteins for tofu, tempeh, or extra veggies. 3. **Check Online Menus** – Many of the sites above list vegetarian options directly on their menu pages, so you can preview what’s available before you go. 4. **Delivery & Takeout** – All of these places offer delivery via UberEats, DoorDash, or their own online ordering system, which is handy if you prefer to dine at home. Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
